tokenStreamMapping.C
Go to the documentation of this file.
1 /*
2 // This file supports the new parse tree support in ROSE.
3 // specifically this is a "Concrete Syntax Augmented AST"
4 // Because the ROSE IR is close to that of the C/C++/Fortran
5 // grammar the parse tree can be derived from the token stream
6 // and the AST. The principal representation of the CSA AST
7 // is a map using the IR nodes of the AST as keys into the map
8 // and the map elements being a data structure (TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping)
9 // containing three pairs of indexes representing the subsequence
10 // of tokens for the leading tokens (often white space), the token
11 // subsequence for the AST IR node (including its subtree), and
12 // the trailing token subsequence (often white space).
13 
14 // So where the AST might be:
15 // SgWhileStmt
16 // / \
17 // SgStatement SgStatement
18 // (predicate) (body)
19 //
20 // The associated parse tree would be:
21 //
22 // SgWhileStmt
23 // / / \ \ \
24 // "while" "(" SgStatement ")" SgStatement
25 // (predicate) (body)
26 //
27 // (so much for ASCI art).
28 //
29 
30 // We have a number of ways that we expect could be a problem for this
31 // token stream mapping (possible failure modes):
32 // 1) Toky() macro to write code (not working yet)
33 // 2) Token pasting operator ## (WORKS)
34 // 3) Use equivalent of generated binary as a test for generate source code
35 // that is equivalent to the input file up to the use of new lines and other
36 // white space (THIS IS NOT A GREAT TEST (unless the filename of the generated
37 // code is made the same)).
38 // 4) Use multiple variable names in the same variable declaration (FIXED).
39 //
40 // Each of these are being addressed before moving this code into ROSE,
41 // merging it with the Wave support, and modifying the unparser to
42 // use the token stream support.
43 */
44

332 // int input_leading_whitespace_end, int input_token_subsequence_start, int input_token_subsequence_end, int input_trailing_whitespace_start,

334 TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping*
335 TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping::createTokenInterval (SgSourceFile* sourceFile, SgNode* n, int input_leading_whitespace_start, int input_leading_whitespace_end, int input_token_subsequence_start, int input_token_subsequence_end, int input_trailing_whitespace_start, int input_trailing_whitespace_end, int input_else_whitespace_start, int input_else_whitespace_end)
336  {
337  // The token interval is unique and using it we define an interval tree (of tokens) on the AST to seperate the token stream over the AST IR nodes.
338  // This function defines a set which used a unique key for any possible interval.
339 
340  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenStreamSize > 0);
341 
342  // DQ (4/21/2021): Adding support for multiple files (including header files).
343  ROSE_ASSERT(sourceFile != NULL);
344 
345  // Generate the key from the node and token subsequence interval.
346  // TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping_key key(n,input_token_subsequence_start,input_token_subsequence_end);
347  TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping_key key(sourceFile,n,input_token_subsequence_start,input_token_subsequence_end);
348 
349  TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* newTokenSequence = NULL;
350  // map<size_t,TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping*>::iterator iter = tokenSequencePool.find(key);
351  map<TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping_key,TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping*>::iterator iter = tokenSequencePool.find(key);
352 
353  if (iter != tokenSequencePool.end())
354  {
355  // This branch will permit sharing of a previously built TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping.
356  newTokenSequence = iter->second;
357  ROSE_ASSERT(newTokenSequence != NULL);
358 #if 0
359  printf ("TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping::createTokenInterval(): Reuse an existing TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping newTokenSequence = %p = %s \n",newTokenSequence,newTokenSequence->node->class_name().c_str());

361  printf (" --- newTokenSequence->token_subsequence_start = %d newTokenSequence->token_subsequence_end = %d \n",newTokenSequence->token_subsequence_start,newTokenSequence->token_subsequence_end);
362  printf (" --- input_leading_whitespace_start = %d input_leading_whitespace_end = %d \n",input_leading_whitespace_start,input_leading_whitespace_end);
363  printf (" --- input_trailing_whitespace_start = %d input_trailing_whitespace_end = %d \n",input_trailing_whitespace_start,input_trailing_whitespace_end);
364 #endif
365  newTokenSequence->shared = true;
366 
367  ROSE_ASSERT(newTokenSequence->shared == true);
368 
369  // Add the first node to the list.
370  newTokenSequence->nodeVector.push_back(n);
371 #if 0
372  printf (" --- newTokenSequence->nodeVector.size() = %zu \n",newTokenSequence->nodeVector.size());
373 #endif
374  }
375  else
376  {
377  // This branch will force a new TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping to be built.

379  ROSE_ASSERT(newTokenSequence != NULL);

384  printf (" --- input_leading_whitespace_start = %d input_leading_whitespace_end = %d \n",input_leading_whitespace_start,input_leading_whitespace_end);
385  printf (" --- input_trailing_whitespace_start = %d input_trailing_whitespace_end = %d \n",input_trailing_whitespace_start,input_trailing_whitespace_end);
386 #endif
387  newTokenSequence->shared = false;

389  ROSE_ASSERT(newTokenSequence->shared == false);

392  newTokenSequence->nodeVector.push_back(n);

585 void
586 TokenMappingTraversal::consistancyCheck()
587  {
588  static int counter = 0;
589 
590  // This function is commented out when ERROR_CONSISTANCY_CHECKING is defined to be 0
591 
592 #if ERROR_CHECKING
593  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() == tokenStreamSequenceVector.size());
594 
595  for (size_t i = 0; i < tokenStreamSequenceVector.size(); i++)
596  {
597  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenStreamSequenceVector[i] != NULL);
598  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node != NULL);
599  if (tokenStreamSequenceMap.find(tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node) == tokenStreamSequenceMap.end())
600  {
601  printf ("Error: cannot find (might be from another file): tokenStreamSequenceVector[i=%" PRIuPTR "] = %p node = %p = %s name = %s \n",
602  i,tokenStreamSequenceVector[i],tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node,tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node->class_name().c_str(),
603  SageInterface::get_name(tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node).c_str());
604  // tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node->get_file_info()->display("error: can't find node in tokenStreamSequenceMap: debug");
605  printf (" --- node from file = %s \n",tokenStreamSequenceVector[i]->node->get_file_info()->get_filenameString().c_str());
606 
607 #if 0
608  // DQ (4/19/2021): When handling header files, we can visit IR nodes (from other header files)
609  // that are not in the tokenStreamSequenceVector associated with the current file.
610  printf ("Error: TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* element in tokenStreamSequenceVector not found in tokenStreamSequenceMap \n");
611  ROSE_ABORT();
612 #endif
613  }
614  }
615 #endif
616 
617  // The map is the more useful data structure longer term, but we need the tokenStreamSequenceVector
618  // to build the initial sequence (though a better approach might not need the tokenStreamSequenceVector
619  // data strcuture and could maybe use the tokenStreamSequenceMap exclusively.
620 
621  // DQ (12/3/2014): Make this an error message (fails for amr/Coarsen_particles.cc).
622  // ROSE_ASSERT(tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() == tokenStreamSequenceVector.size());
623  if (tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() != tokenStreamSequenceVector.size())
624  {
625 #if 0
626  printf ("ERROR: TokenMappingTraversal::consistancyCheck(): tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() != tokenStreamSequenceVector.size() \n");
627  printf (" --- tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() = %zu \n",tokenStreamSequenceMap.size());
628  printf (" --- tokenStreamSequenceVector.size() = %zu \n",tokenStreamSequenceVector.size());
629 #else
630  if (tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() < tokenStreamSequenceVector.size())
631  {
632  // DQ (1/3/2014): Supress too much output from this warning. I think this is caused by the tokenization not handeling line continuation characters "\".
633  if (counter % 1000 == 0)
634  {
635  printf ("ERROR: TokenMappingTraversal::consistancyCheck(): tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() < tokenStreamSequenceVector.size() \n");
636  printf (" --- tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() = %zu \n",tokenStreamSequenceMap.size());
637  printf (" --- tokenStreamSequenceVector.size() = %zu \n",tokenStreamSequenceVector.size());
638  }
639  counter++;
640  }
641 #endif
642  }
643 
644  // DQ (1/6/2015): Test the tokenStreamSequenceMap to make sure there are no NULL entries.
645  map<SgNode*,TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping*>::iterator i = tokenStreamSequenceMap.begin();
646  while (i != tokenStreamSequenceMap.end())
647  {
648  ROSE_ASSERT(i->first != NULL);
649  ROSE_ASSERT(i->second != NULL);
650 
651  i++;
652  }
653  }

667 string
668 Graph_TokenMappingTraversal::getTokenIdString (int i)
669  {
670  string s;
671  switch (i)
672  {
673  case C_CXX_SYNTAX: s = "syntax"; break;
674  case C_CXX_WHITESPACE: s = "whitespace"; break;
675  case C_CXX_PRAGMA: s = "pragma"; break;
676  case C_CXX_IDENTIFIER: s = "identifier"; break;
677  case C_CXX_PREPROCESSING_INFO: s = "CPP PREPROCESSING INFO"; break;
678 
679  default:
680  {
681  if (i >= C_CXX_ASM && i <= C_CXX_WHILE)
682  {
683  s = "keyword";
684  }
685  else
686  {
687  printf ("Error: not clear what this token is: i = %d \n",i);
688  ROSE_ABORT();
689  }
690  }
691  }
692 
693  return s;
694  }

697 void
698 Graph_TokenMappingTraversal::visit(SgNode* n)
699  {
700  if (n != NULL)
701  {
702  // Add a node to the graph
703  string node_name = n->class_name();
704 
705  string label = "";
706 
707  // DQ (12/21/2014): Output names of associated declarations.
708  SgFunctionDeclaration* functionDeclaration = isSgFunctionDeclaration(n);
709  if (functionDeclaration != NULL)
710  {
711  label += string("\n name = ") + functionDeclaration->get_name().str();
712  }
713 
714  // DQ (12/21/2014): Output names of associated declarations.
715  SgClassDeclaration* classDeclaration = isSgClassDeclaration(n);
716  if (classDeclaration != NULL)
717  {
718  label += string("\n name = ") + classDeclaration->get_name().str();
719  }
720 
721  // This could be a seperate subgraph...if it were seperated from this AST traversal into a seperate AST traversal.
722  // Check if we have strored token information about this AST IR node.
723  if (tokenStreamSequenceMap.find(n) != tokenStreamSequenceMap.end())
724  {
725  TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* mapping = tokenStreamSequenceMap[n];
726  ROSE_ASSERT(mapping != NULL);
727 
728  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenList.empty() == false);
729 
730  // label += "YYY";
731  Sg_File_Info* start_pos = mapping->node->get_startOfConstruct();
732  Sg_File_Info* end_pos = mapping->node->get_endOfConstruct();
733 
734  if (end_pos == NULL)
735  {
736 #if 0
737  printf ("WARNING: end_pos == NULL: n = %p = %s \n",n,n->class_name().c_str());
738 #endif
739  // We might want to handle this better (with a properly initialized ending Sg_File_Info for a SgFile).
740  end_pos = start_pos;
741  }
742 
743  label += "\\ncompiler generated = " + string(start_pos->isCompilerGenerated() ? "true" : "false");
744 
745  // Output the mapping so that we can easily see where the same mapping is being used for multiple IR nodes.
746  label += "\\ninterval map entry = " + StringUtility::numberToString(mapping);
747 
748  // Output if this is a shared token sequence across more than one IR node.
749  label += (mapping->shared == true) ? "\\nshared == true" : "\\nshared == false";
750 
751  // Report if this was built as part of the evaluation of the synthesized attribute
752  // (representing fillin of the token sequence more accurately computed using the
753  // evaluateInheritedAttribute() function which uses source position information).
754  label += (mapping->constructedInEvaluationOfSynthesizedAttribute == true) ? "\\nconstructedInEvaluationOfSynthesizedAttribute == true" : "\\nconstructedInEvaluationOfSynthesizedAttribute == false";
755 
756  // printf (" --- node = %p = %s: start (line=%d:column=%d) end(line=%d,column=%d) \n",
757  // mappingInfo->node,mappingInfo->node->class_name().c_str(),start_pos->get_physical_line(),

759  label += "\\nnode pos ((line=" + StringUtility::numberToString(start_pos->get_physical_line()) + ":column=" + StringUtility::numberToString(start_pos->get_col()) + ")"
760  ",(line=" + StringUtility::numberToString(end_pos->get_physical_line()) + ",column=" + StringUtility::numberToString(end_pos->get_col()) + ")) ";
761 
762  int leading_whitespace_start = mapping->leading_whitespace_start;
763  int leading_whitespace_end = mapping->leading_whitespace_end;
764  int token_subsequence_start = mapping->token_subsequence_start;
765  int token_subsequence_end = mapping->token_subsequence_end;
766  int trailing_whitespace_start = mapping->trailing_whitespace_start;
767  int trailing_whitespace_end = mapping->trailing_whitespace_end;
768  int else_whitespace_start = mapping->else_whitespace_start;
769  int else_whitespace_end = mapping->else_whitespace_end;
770 #if 0

1431 TokenMappingTraversal::discoverElseSyntax(TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* if_statement_mappingInfo, TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* true_body_mappingInfo, TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* false_body_mappingInfo)
1432  {
1433  // Search forward through the token sequence to find the first non-whitespace token.
1434 
1435  int else_whitespace_start = true_body_mappingInfo->token_subsequence_end + 1;
1436  int else_whitespace_end = else_whitespace_start;
1437 
1438  int original_end_of_token_subsequence = false_body_mappingInfo->token_subsequence_start + 0;
1439 
1440 #if 0
1441  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): before loop: else_whitespace_start = %d \n",else_whitespace_start);
1442  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): before loop: else_whitespace_end = %d \n",else_whitespace_end);
1443  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): before loop: original_end_of_token_subsequence = %d \n",original_end_of_token_subsequence);
1444 #endif
1445 
1446  // DQ (12/26/2014): Modify to only adjust the white space if there exists some whitespace to start with.
1447  if ( tokenStream[else_whitespace_end]->p_tok_elem->token_id == C_CXX_WHITESPACE ||
1448  tokenStream[else_whitespace_end]->p_tok_elem->token_id == C_CXX_PREPROCESSING_INFO )
1449  {
1450  // while (leading_whitespace_start > original_start_of_token_subsequence && tokenStream[leading_whitespace_start-1]->p_tok_elem->token_id == C_CXX_WHITESPACE)
1451  while ( else_whitespace_end < original_end_of_token_subsequence &&
1452  ( tokenStream[else_whitespace_end]->p_tok_elem->token_id == C_CXX_WHITESPACE ||
1453  tokenStream[else_whitespace_end]->p_tok_elem->token_id == C_CXX_PREPROCESSING_INFO) )
1454  {
1455 #if 0
1456  printf ("in loop: else_whitespace_end = %d \n",else_whitespace_end);
1457 #endif
1458  ROSE_ASSERT(else_whitespace_end < original_end_of_token_subsequence);
1459 
1460  else_whitespace_end++;
1461  }
1462 
1463 #if 0
1464  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): after loop: else_whitespace_end = %d \n",else_whitespace_end);
1465 #endif
1466 
1467  // If the positions are out of bounds then we don't have any leading whitespace.
1468  if (else_whitespace_end > original_end_of_token_subsequence && else_whitespace_start > original_end_of_token_subsequence)
1469  {
1470  else_whitespace_start = -1;
1471  else_whitespace_end = -1;
1472  }
1473  }
1474  else
1475  {
1476 #if 0
1477  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): no initial whitespace detected to start the loop (reset to not define whitespace) \n");
1478 #endif
1479  else_whitespace_start = -1;
1480  else_whitespace_end = -1;
1481  }
1482 
1483  // Set the else_whitespace_start to the end (since "else" is a single token.
1484  else_whitespace_start = else_whitespace_end;
1485 
1486  if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_start = else_whitespace_start;
1487  if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_end = else_whitespace_end;
1488 
1489 #if 0
1490  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): (adjusted) if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_start = %d \n",if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_start);
1491  printf ("In discoverElseSyntax(): (adjusted) if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_end = %d \n",if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_end);
1492 #endif
1493 
1494  ROSE_ASSERT(if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_end == if_statement_mappingInfo->else_whitespace_start);
1495 
1496 #if 0
1497  printf ("Exiting as a test! \n");
1498  ROSE_ABORT();
1499 #endif
1500  }

6970 outputSourceCodeFromTokenStream_globalScope(SgSourceFile* sourceFile, vector<stream_element*> tokenVector, map<SgNode*,TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping*> & tokenStreamSequenceMap, bool preferTrailingWhitespaceInOutput)

6972 #if 0

6976 #else
6977  bool preferTrailingWhitespaceInOutput = false;

6992 
6993 #if 0

6997  }

6999 
7000  // Open file...(file is declared in the EDG_ROSE_Graph namespace).
7001  std::ofstream file;
7002  file.open(filename.c_str());
7003 
7004  // Output the opening header for a DOT file.
7005  // file << "digraph \"" << dot_header << "\" {" << endl;
7006 
7007  SgDeclarationStatementPtrList & declarationList = globalScope->getDeclarationList();
7008 
7009 #if 0
7010  printf ("declarationList.size() = %zu \n",declarationList.size());
7011  printf ("tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() = %zu \n",tokenStreamSequenceMap.size());
7012 #endif
7013 
7014  // The two allowed IR nodes are SgSourceFile and the SgGlobal (global scope)
7015  // if (declarationList.empty() == true)
7016  if (tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() <= 2)
7017  {
7018  // This case handled the trivial case of a file without any statements (could have #include files).
7019 #if 0
7020  printf ("Note: tokenStreamSequenceMap.size() <= 2 \n");
7021 #endif
7022  TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* tokenSubsequence = tokenStreamSequenceMap[globalScope];
7023  if (tokenSubsequence->token_subsequence_start != -1)
7024  {
7025  for (int j = tokenSubsequence->token_subsequence_start; j <= tokenSubsequence->token_subsequence_end; j++)
7026  {
7027  file << tokenVector[j]->p_tok_elem->token_lexeme;
7028  }
7029  }
7030  }
7031  else
7032  {
7033  size_t firstDeclarationOutput = 0;
7034 
7035  bool ignore_firstDeclarationOutput = false;
7036 
7037  bool skipSharedSequences = false;
7038 
7039  for (size_t i = 0; i < declarationList.size(); i++)
7040  {
7041 #if 0
7042  printf ("declarationList[i=%zu of %zu] = %p = %s \n",i,declarationList.size(),declarationList[i],declarationList[i]->class_name().c_str());
7043 #endif
7044  // ROSE_ASSERT(tokenStreamSequenceMap.find(declarationList[i]) != tokenStreamSequenceMap.end());
7045  if (tokenStreamSequenceMap.find(declarationList[i]) != tokenStreamSequenceMap.end())
7046  {
7047  TokenStreamSequenceToNodeMapping* tokenSubsequence = tokenStreamSequenceMap[declarationList[i]];
7048  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenSubsequence != NULL);
7049 #if 0
7050  printf ("firstDeclarationOutput = %zu \n",firstDeclarationOutput);
7051 #endif
7052  // The first declaration is not alwasy the first tokenSubsequence.
7053  // if (i == 0)
7054  if (i == firstDeclarationOutput)
7055  {
7056  if (preferTrailingWhitespaceInOutput == true)
7057  {
7058  // Output the leading white space.
7059  if (tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_start != -1)
7060  {
7061  for (int j = tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_start; j <= tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_end; j++)
7062  {
7063  file << tokenVector[j]->p_tok_elem->token_lexeme;
7064  }
7065  }
7066  }
7067 
7068  ignore_firstDeclarationOutput = true;
7069  }
7070 
7071  if (skipSharedSequences == false)
7072  {
7073  if (preferTrailingWhitespaceInOutput == false)
7074  {
7075  // We need to always output the leading token stream for each declaration.
7076  // Output the leading white space.
7077 #if 0
7078  printf ("tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_start = %d tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_end = %d \n",tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_start,tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_end);
7079 #endif
7080  if (tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_start != -1)
7081  {
7082  for (int j = tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_start; j <= tokenSubsequence->leading_whitespace_end; j++)
7083  {
7084 #if 0
7085  printf ("j = %d \n",j);
7086 #endif
7087  file << tokenVector[j]->p_tok_elem->token_lexeme;
7088  }
7089  }
7090  }
7091 
7092  // Output the leading white space.
7093  if (tokenSubsequence->token_subsequence_start != -1)
7094  {
7095  for (int j = tokenSubsequence->token_subsequence_start; j <= tokenSubsequence->token_subsequence_end; j++)
7096  {
7097  file << tokenVector[j]->p_tok_elem->token_lexeme;
7098  }
7099  }
7100 
7101  if (preferTrailingWhitespaceInOutput == true)
7102  {
7103  // We need to always output the trailing token stream for each declaration.
7104  // if (i+1 == declarationList.size())
7105  // Output the trailing white space.
7106 #if 0
7107  printf ("tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_start = %d tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_end = %d \n",tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_start,tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_end);
7108 #endif
7109  if (tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_start != -1)
7110  {
7111  for (int j = tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_start; j <= tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_end; j++)
7112  {
7113 #if 0
7114  printf ("j = %d \n",j);
7115 #endif
7116  file << tokenVector[j]->p_tok_elem->token_lexeme;
7117  }
7118  }
7119  }
7120  }
7121 
7122  if (preferTrailingWhitespaceInOutput == false)
7123  {
7124  // I think this might be a better way to handle the trailing edge of the last statement (when we
7125  // are giving a prefeence to generated the ouput using the leading subsequence between statements).
7126  // If we are giving preference to leading white space and we are at the last
7127  // declaration, then output the trailing whitespace to close off the file.
7128  if (i == declarationList.size()-1)
7129  {
7130  // Output the leading white space.
7131  if (tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_start != -1)
7132  {
7133  for (int j = tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_start; j <= tokenSubsequence->trailing_whitespace_end; j++)
7134  {
7135  file << tokenVector[j]->p_tok_elem->token_lexeme;
7136  }
7137  }
7138  }
7139  }
7140 
7141  if (tokenSubsequence->shared == true)
7142  {
7143  ROSE_ASSERT(tokenSubsequence->nodeVector.empty() == false);
7144 
7145  // When we get to the last IR node for which this token sequence is shared then turn off skipSharedSequences.
7146  if (declarationList[i] == tokenSubsequence->nodeVector[tokenSubsequence->nodeVector.size()-1])
7147  {
7148  skipSharedSequences = false;
7149  }
7150  else
7151  {
7152  skipSharedSequences = true;
7153  }
7154 #if 0
7155  printf ("Set skipSharedSequences = %s \n",skipSharedSequences ? "true" : "false");
7156 #endif
7157  }
7158  }
7159  else
7160  {
7161  // We want to ignore the first declaration after we have output its associate leading tokens sequence.
7162  if (ignore_firstDeclarationOutput == false)
7163  {
7164  firstDeclarationOutput++;
7165  }
7166  }
7167  }
7168  }
7169 
7170  // Close off the generated file.
7171  file.close();
7172  }
